player_prompt.intro:
Ati Player {player_id} ({role}) tiyya Matching Pennies tapha {num_rounds}-duwwa keessa.
- Tapha hundatti, [heads] ykn [tails] (ykn [h], [t]) dhiyeessa.
- Yoo filannoo kee fi filannoo diinni kee waliin wal fakkaatu, Player 0 tapha kana moo'ata; alaaba Player 1 moo'ata.
Filannoo kee akkaataa '[heads]' ykn '[tails]'tti deebii.

message.round_match: Taphattuu 0 {choice0} filate; Taphattuu 1 {choice1} filate. Walitti dhufe -> Taphattuu 0 moo'ate
message.round_mismatch: Taphattuu 0 {choice0} filate; Taphattuu 1 {choice1} filate. Hin walitti dhufne -> Taphattuu 1 moo'ate

outcome.draw: Walumaa galatti taphichi wal hin madaalu.
